a living income reference price and in exchange for doing those things they have to let us audit and remediate the child labor on the farms and so uh in this five uh village case that we did, there's around 10 ,000 people living in there.
And about seven months ago, there's around 550 kids that were in illegal child labor in those communities.
And so then we started taking over sourcing from there.
So we started doing our sourcing principles and paying the Farmers Living Game Ref Prince Prize.
Fairtrade came in, come in, started paying the premium.
And now seven months later, we just got the initial results after we did our check -ins.

And some of communities, we were getting so many kids out of child labor, there literally wasn't a school because kids just Some of these we literally built a school so they could go to school because the goal isn't just to get the kids out of child labor.
It's also to get them an education.
So they're not, you know, because if you grow up only working on a cacao farm, you have no education.
So then you're basically doomed to working on it your whole life, you know, because you don't know anything else, right?
And so we just did our recent wave of check -ins where we knocked on all the doors, checked school attendance and everything.
And so seven months ago, it was 550 kids -ish roughly in illegal child labor.
What do you think it was now, basically six, seven months later?
I don't know.
How many?
90 % reduction and get it to where there's only like around 50 still in child labor with our first check -in.
And now we constitute a kid remediated out of child labor with two check -ins.
So that was just the first one.
So technically by our books, they wouldn't be fully remediated because there might've been an accident or whatever.
So we like to double check it to make sure things are accurate.
So we'll do another check -in in the future.
So they're not technically officially remediated, but it just shows that it's possible to reduce the child labor in these areas dramatically.
If you were to apply the things we did there, whole country.
I mean, you're talking, you could get swarms of hundreds of thousands of kids out of illegal child labor.
And so my, the big way I've been doing or been on is like, step one is to prove it's possible.
